items.defectStatement: The sync-mode token schema uses stringified Zod objects as literal property names instead of defining expiry fields or preserving additional properties. Parsing strips fields such as expires_in, expiry_date, and refresh_token, causing invalid expiry calculations and loss of refreshed credential data.
obligations: Preserve expires_in and expiry_date and validate them as numbers when present.
Preserve additional provider fields, including an actual refresh_token.
Allow providers that do not return expiry fields.
items.notes: A suitable catchall is also valid. Do not require every provider to return both expiry fields.

items.defectStatement: Salesforce credential persistence references prisma without importing or locally defining it. This can throw a ReferenceError in production, where the Prisma module does not initialize globalThis.prisma.
obligations: Resolve the shared Prisma client explicitly before calling credential.update.
Continue awaiting persistence for the same credential ID.
Preserve the refreshed token data and existing refresh_token.
items.notes: A dynamic import fits the exact anchor; a conventional top-level import requires editing outside it. The repository declares a global prisma, so the claimed unresolved-name type error is not guaranteed. The closing }); lies outside the anchor.

items.defectStatement: Salesforce token refresh checks whether statusText equals "OK" rather than checking HTTP success. A successful response with an empty or different reason phrase is incorrectly rejected.
obligations: Accept successful HTTP responses regardless of statusText.
Continue throwing an HttpError for unsuccessful HTTP responses.
items.exampleFix: if (!response.ok) throw new HttpError({ statusCode: 400, message: response.statusText });
items.notes: The gold description also mentions stale-token use; that separate defect is covered by item #17.

items.defectStatement: After persisting refreshed Salesforce credentials, getClient constructs jsforce.Connection using the old access_token and instance_url. The returned connection therefore uses stale authentication and potentially an outdated instance endpoint.
obligations: Initialize the connection with the refreshed access_token.
Use the instance_url returned by the refresh.
Preserve awaited credential persistence and the existing refresh_token.
Preserve client configuration and redirect URI.
items.notes: The missing Prisma import is a separate defect covered by #14; this replacement addresses stale connection credentials.

items.defectStatement: The credential webhook indexes appStoreMetadata by database slug, although its keys are integration directory names. Valid apps such as google-calendar consequently receive a 404 and cannot synchronize credentials.
obligations: Resolve metadata by matching its slug to the database app slug.
Support apps whose directory name differs from their slug.
Preserve the 404 response when no matching metadata exists.
Retain the matching metadata's slug and type for downstream credential operations.
items.notes: The closing brace of the 404 guard lies outside the anchor and must not be duplicated.
